standard: IEEE 1800-2023 6.24.2: when called as a function, $cast assigns the source to the destination and returns 1 only if the assignment is valid; a value that is no member of an enumerated destination type is invalid, so the function returns 0 and makes no assignment.
method: The shared case runs unchanged in verify-sv-verilator, verify-sv-icarus and verify-sv-xezim; the reduced source below runs without the adapters (verilator --binary --top-module Wrapped, iverilog -g2012 -s Wrapped, xezim -s Wrapped and xezim -s Top, and the Celox sv_tests driver in simulation mode with each top).
